dossier.purpose: Python library, CLI and stdio MCP server for local code search aimed at coding agents. It chunks files with tree-sitter (about 750 characters per chunk) and embeds the chunks with a static Model2Vec model (default minishlab/potion-code-16M-v2). It also builds a BM25 index, fuses the two rankings with RRF and reranks with code-aware boosts and penalties. It indexes local directories or git URLs, searches several repos as one corpus, and caches indexes on disk with incremental mtime-based reindexing. `semble install` writes MCP, instruction and sub-agent configs for 19 coding agents, including Claude Code and Codex. Version 0.6.1, Python >=3.10. The embedding model runs in-process: no embedding-service client was found in src/.

claims.claim: Semble is a code search library built for agents; 'Everything runs on CPU with no API keys, GPU, or external services.'
Usable as an MCP server, a CLI tool via AGENTS.md, or a dedicated sub-agent; any coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, etc.) gets access to any repo.

Install uv, run `uv tool install semble` then `semble install`. The installer detects installed agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode...) and lets you enable an MCP server, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instructions and a `semble-search` sub-agent. `semble uninstall` undoes it.

Retrieval = tree-sitter code-aware chunks scored by two retrievers (static Model2Vec embeddings with potion-code-16M-v2, plus BM25), fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and reranked with code-aware signals. There is no transformer forward pass at query time.

Local and remote: pass a local path or a git URL, or several of them, to search related repos together. Each repo index is cached separately and merged at query time; result paths are prefixed with the repo name and the output includes a `repos` map.

Indexes are built and cached on first run and invalidated automatically when files change. On later runs file modification times are compared and only added/removed/changed files are reindexed; a full rebuild happens only if indexing settings change.

MCP server exposes `search` and `find_related`; repos are indexed on demand and cached; local paths are re-indexed automatically on file changes ('checked and refreshed automatically as files change').

Scoping: reads .gitignore and .sembleignore (gitignore syntax, recursive; `!*.ext` force-includes), always skips node_modules/.venv/dist/build/__pycache__; `--content code|docs|config|all`; files over 1 MB are skipped (SEMBLE_MAX_FILE_BYTES).

Indexes and savings stats are stored in the OS cache folder (~/.cache/semble/ on Linux, ~/Library/Caches/semble/ on macOS), overridable with SEMBLE_CACHE_LOCATION; `semble clear index|savings|orphans|all` removes cached data.
On first use Semble downloads the embedding model from Hugging Face into the standard HF cache; this happens once and requires network access.
SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME can point to a local path or Hugging Face repo containing a Model2Vec-compatible model; useful if Hugging Face is not reachable at runtime.

Performance: indexes an average repo in ~500 ms and answers queries in ~1 ms on CPU; NDCG@10 0.854, on par with code-specialized transformers; ~99% fewer tokens than grep+read; ~380x faster indexing and ~17x faster queries than CodeRankEmbed.
Python library API: SembleIndex.from_path / from_git / merge / search / find_related with ContentType selection (code, docs, config).
Configs written by `semble install` (MCP entry, instructions, sub-agent files) pin uvx to the installed version (`semble[mcp]==X.Y.Z`); rerun `semble install` after upgrading.

platforms.wsl2: unknown - WSL is not mentioned anywhere in the repo (case-insensitive search for 'wsl' returned nothing), and CI does not test it. It would report sys.platform == 'linux' and take the Linux code path (src/semble/cache.py:85-86), but that is an inference.
platforms.macos_arm64: yes - README documents the macOS cache path (README.md:185); CI runs on macos-latest (ci.yaml:18; the workflow does not state the architecture); semble-grammars macosx_11_0_arm64 wheel is locked (uv.lock:3906).
platforms.gpu: no - not used or required: 'runs on CPU with no API keys, GPU, or external services' (README.md:27, README.md:83). Embeddings are a static Model2Vec lookup (src/semble/index/dense.py:44-50), and src/ has no CUDA/GPU code path (only a '.cu' to cuda file-extension mapping, src/semble/index/files.py:79-80).

integrations.cli: yes - `semble search`, `find-related`, `savings`, `clear`, `install`, `uninstall`, `--version`; JSON output by default (src/semble/cli.py:266-346, cli.py:69; README.md:91-116).
integrations.mcp: yes - stdio MCP server, started by running `semble` with no subcommand; needs the `mcp` extra (cli.py:96-115; pyproject.toml:40-42). Tools: `search` and `find_related` (src/semble/mcp.py:85-169; README.md:241-246). Transport is stdio only (mcp.py:194).
integrations.sdk_or_api: SDK: yes - Python library `from semble import SembleIndex, ContentType` with from_path / from_git / merge / search / find_related / save / load_from_disk (src/semble/__init__.py:1-13; src/semble/index/index.py:132-407; README.md:200-233). HTTP API: none found (no HTTP server code; only stdio, mcp.py:194).
integrations.claude_code_or_codex: Both documented. Claude Code: `claude mcp add semble -s user -- uvx --from "semble[mcp]" semble` (docs/installation.md:58). `semble install` writes the MCP entry to ~/.claude.json, an instruction block to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and a sub-agent to ~/.claude/agents/semble-search.md (src/semble/installer/agents.py:186-194). Codex: [mcp_servers.semble] in ~/.codex/config.toml (docs/installation.md:84-90), instructions in ~/.codex/AGENTS.md and sub-agent ~/.codex/agents/semble-search.toml (agents.py:240-248; templates src/semble/agents/claude.md, src/semble/agents/codex.toml). Installer paths are user-level/global only; no project-scope config is written.

readme.telemetry_and_network: No telemetry, analytics or phone-home code found. A regex search of src/ for HTTP clients (requests/httpx/aiohttp/urllib.request/socket), telemetry SDKs and API-key/base-URL settings matched only `urllib.parse`/`url2pathname` for path conversion (src/semble/installer/agents.py:12-13) and a Hugging Face log filter (src/semble/index/dense.py:19-21). Local-only usage stats: each search/find_related appends {timestamp, call type, result count, snippet chars, file chars} to <cache>/savings.jsonl, with no query text or paths (src/semble/stats.py:21-23, stats.py:57-94). Network IS used for: (1) first-use unauthenticated model download from the Hugging Face Hub into the HF cache (README.md:189; dense.py:19-33; the model2vec/huggingface_hub code was not read); (2) `git clone --depth 1` for git-URL repos, 60 s default timeout via the undocumented SEMBLE_CLONE_TIMEOUT (src/semble/index/index.py:31, index.py:249-259); (3) uv fetching the pinned `semble[mcp]==<version>` from PyPI when an agent launches the MCP command (agents.py:62-69, agents.py:93-126; docs/installation.md:44). No account, token or API key is required (README.md:27, README.md:83). Env vars read: SEMBLE_CACHE_LOCATION, SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME, SEMBLE_MAX_FILE_BYTES, SEMBLE_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT, SEMBLE_CLONE_TIMEOUT, XDG_CACHE_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME.

languages: Markdown and TOML (agent templates in src/semble/agents/, docs)

entry_points.what: main(): dispatches to CLI subcommands (search, find-related, install, uninstall, savings, clear, --version) when argv[1] is one of them; otherwise starts the MCP server.
_mcp_main(): checks that the `mcp` extra is installed, then runs semble.mcp.serve.
serve(): FastMCP stdio server with tools `search` (line 85) and `find_related` (line 124); the model is preloaded in a background thread.
Library API: SembleIndex, ContentType, Chunk, SearchResult, IndexStats.
run(): interactive or unattended install/uninstall across 19 agent targets.
Benchmark runners (`python -m benchmarks.run_benchmark`, speed_benchmark, baselines.*); not part of the shipped package.

code.architecture: Single Python package src/semble. Pipeline: index/file_walker.py walks files (.gitignore + .sembleignore + default-ignored dirs, symlinks skipped). index/files.py holds a large extension-to-language table and the code/docs/config content-type split. chunking/ splits files with tree-sitter grammars from the separate `semble-grammars` package into ~750-char chunks (chunking.py:12), with a line-based fallback. index/dense.py embeds chunks with a Model2Vec StaticModel (default minishlab/potion-code-16M-v2, loaded from Hugging Face or a local path) and searches them by brute-force cosine in memory (SelectableBasicBackend over vicinity). index/bm25.py is an in-memory BM25 inverted index persisted as JSON. search.py runs both retrievers, converts scores to RRF (k=60) and blends them with alpha 0.3 for symbol-like queries or 0.5 for natural language (ranking/boosting.py:81-82). ranking/ then applies definition, stem and file-coherence boosts plus test/compat/example/.d.ts penalties. index/index.py is the SembleIndex facade: from_path, from_git (shallow clone into a temp dir), merge for multi-repo, search, find_related, save/load_from_disk. cache.py persists indexes under the OS cache dir at <sha256(resolved path or URL)>/index[-<content scopes>]/ with chunks.json, bm25_index/index.json, semantic_index/ (written by vicinity, not read) and metadata.json (model name, chunk size, cache version, per-file mtime manifest). It validates and incrementally reuses them (cache.py:27-41, 98-202; index/types.py:9-40). mcp.py runs one stdio server process per client launch, with an in-process LRU of at most 10 indexes, optional idle eviction (SEMBLE_MCP_IDLE_TIMEOUT) and an mtime revalidation cooldown. The on-disk cache is shared by CLI and MCP. installer/ plus agents/ write MCP entries, instruction blocks and sub-agent files for 19 agents. stats.py appends local token-savings records.
code.packaging_and_release: Pure-Python distribution built with setuptools (pyproject.toml:1-3). Both `[tool.setuptools.dynamic] version = attr semble.version.__version__` (pyproject.toml:82-83) and `[tool.setuptools_scm]` (lines 79-80) are configured. src/semble/version.py:1-2 reads 0.6.1, matching tag v0.6.1 (.git/packed-refs:2). Agent templates ship as package-data (pyproject.toml:76-77). The sdist excludes benchmarks/, assets/ and uv.lock (MANIFEST.in:1-4). Release: .github/workflows/release.yaml is workflow_dispatch only (lines 3-4). It builds with `uv build` (line 17), uploads dist/ as an artifact, then publishes to PyPI via pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1 using OIDC trusted publishing (environment `release`, `id-token: write`; lines 25-40). The workflow has no test gate (publish only needs `build`), no checksum, signature or SBOM step, no explicit attestation setting, and creates no GitHub Release or binary assets. Its actions use mutable tag/branch refs (release.yaml:11, 14, 20, 34, 40), whereas ci.yaml pins checkout, setup-uv and codecov by SHA (ci.yaml:22, 31, 56). Whether PEP 740 attestations are produced depends on the third-party action's defaults, which were not verified.
code.tests_and_ci: pytest>=8 with pytest-cov (pyproject.toml:51-58, 135-137). tests/ has 15 test files (11 in tests/, 4 in tests/index/) plus conftest.py, and 199 `def test_` definitions (many parametrized): cache, chunker, CLI incl. clear, file walker, files, git (local repos), installer (50), MCP (23, fake indexes), ranking, search, stats, bm25/create/dense/index. The embedding model is mocked throughout (tests/conftest.py:75-90; every load_model/from_pretrained call in tests/ is patched), so no test runs the real model end-to-end. CI: .github/workflows/ci.yaml runs on push and PR to main, matrix ubuntu/macos/windows-latest x Python 3.10-3.14 (15 jobs). Steps: `uv venv`, `uv pip install '.[dev,mcp]'`, `pytest` (with coverage), Codecov upload. CI has no lint, mypy or pydoclint step; those run only via pre-commit (.pre-commit-config.yaml:23-41) and the Makefile (Makefile:22-27). The tests were not run for this dossier.

claim_checks.claim: Everything runs on CPU with no API keys, GPU, or external services (README.md:27, 83).
claim_checks.evidence: True for query time. src/ has no HTTP client, API-key or embedding-service code (regex search matched only urllib.parse in installer/agents.py:12-13 and a log filter in index/dense.py:19-21), and embeddings are an in-process Model2Vec StaticModel (index/dense.py:24-50). But first use downloads the model from Hugging Face (README.md:189; dense.py:31-33), git-URL repos need `git clone` (index/index.py:249-253), and uvx fetches the pinned package from PyPI when an MCP client launches the server (installer/agents.py:62-69). Fully offline use requires SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME to be a local Model2Vec path (utils.py:67-69).

claim_checks.claim: Indexes are cached to disk, reindexed incrementally by modification time, and fully rebuilt only if indexing settings change (README.md:281).
claim_checks.evidence: cache.py:98-110 invalidates on model-name, content-set, chunk-size (750, chunking/chunking.py:12) or CACHE_FORMAT_VERSION (index/types.py:9) mismatch. cache.py:128-156 compares file mtimes with the index write time and the stored file set. index/create.py:128-134 reuses chunks and vectors for files whose mtime_ns is unchanged and re-embeds only changed files; removed files are dropped (create.py:144-145). Caveats: staleness is mtime-only (no content hash), and git-URL indexes skip revalidation entirely (cache.py:136-137; tests/test_cache.py:268-275). Not executed here.

claim_checks.claim: In MCP mode the index is checked and refreshed automatically as files change, so results stay current (README.md:239, 281).
claim_checks.evidence: mcp.py:273-293 revalidates a local-path entry on each tool call through get_validated_cache and evicts it if stale, so the next call rebuilds incrementally. It is polling on request (no file watcher). Revalidation is skipped for 3x the last build duration (mcp.py:34, 258, 288) and never done for git URLs (mcp.py:282; tests/test_mcp.py:170-191). The README does not mention the cooldown or the git-URL exception.

claim_checks.claim: Local and remote: pass a local path or git URL, or several, to search related repos together (README.md:85, 116).
claim_checks.evidence: cli.py:131-143 builds one index per path/URL and merges them. index/index.py:168-213 SembleIndex.merge checks that all indexes use the same model, labels by repo name, and rejects duplicates. mcp.py:49-57 accepts a string or a list (tests/test_mcp.py:361-376). Difference between clients: MCP rejects non-http(s) git schemes (mcp.py:41-42; tests/test_mcp.py:489-507), while the CLI accepts ssh://, git://, file:// and scp-style URLs (utils.py:9-16; cli.py:34-41).

claim_checks.claim: `semble install` detects Claude Code, Codex, etc. and enables an MCP server, instructions and a sub-agent; `semble uninstall` undoes it (README.md:45-51).
claim_checks.evidence: installer/agents.py:185-360 defines 19 agent targets (Claude Code at 186-194, Codex at 240-248). installer/installer.py:67-107 applies or removes the three integration types. installer/config.py:135-200 and 268-292 edit JSON5/TOML in place and re-parse before writing. tests/test_installer.py covers merge/remove (50 test defs). All target paths are user-level; no project-scope config is written, and no backup of edited files is made (no backup logic found in src/).

claim_checks.claim: Scoping via .gitignore/.sembleignore, default-skipped directories, and a 1 MB file cap (README.md:121-139, 187).
claim_checks.evidence: index/file_walker.py:14-34 lists the default-ignored dirs; 37-49 reads .gitignore and .sembleignore per directory (recursive walk, 107-131); `!ext` negations force-include (97-102, 130); symlinks are skipped (122-123). index/files.py:9 and 493-495 apply the 1 MB default cap (SEMBLE_MAX_FILE_BYTES), and create.py:32-42 warns about skipped files. Doc nit: the README example (README.md:126-129) puts inline `#` comments after patterns and shows `*.pb.go.`; lines are passed unmodified to pathspec (file_walker.py:42-48) and gitignore syntax has no inline comments. This was inferred from the code and not executed.

claim_checks.claim: SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME may be a local path or Hugging Face repo containing a Model2Vec-compatible model (README.md:285).
claim_checks.evidence: utils.py:67-69 reads the variable; index/dense.py:24-41 loads it with StaticModel.from_pretrained. The model name is stored in index metadata and a mismatch forces a rebuild (cache.py:107). No other embedding backend (for example an HTTP or OpenAI-style service) exists in src/. The cache directory is keyed by path and content scope, not by model (cache.py:37-41), so two clients running with different SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME values on one repo would overwrite each other's index. That follows from the code and was not run.

claim_checks.claim: NDCG@10 of 0.854, on par with code-specialized transformers; ~380x faster indexing and ~17x faster queries than CodeRankEmbed (README.md:27, 81, 260).
claim_checks.evidence: 0.8544 appears in benchmarks/results/semble-hybrid-a772a37d558c.json:5 (model potion-code-16M-v2; the four committed semble runs range 0.8519-0.8544). The CodeRankEmbed row (0.839 / 116 s / 16 ms, benchmarks/README.md:21) is a semantic-only dense baseline (benchmarks/README.md:150) compared with semble's hybrid pipeline. Its 63-repo average was not recomputed from coderankembed-812d8e74b9d0.json. Ground-truth queries and labels are LLM-generated and LLM-judged (benchmarks/README.md:136). README ablation values differ from the committed ablation file by up to ~0.012 (benchmarks/README.md:104-106 vs benchmarks/results/semble-ablations-a772a37d558c.json:5-41). Nothing was re-run.

benchmarks/results/token-efficiency-0e2d85215c7e.json:62-68 gives an expected cost of 45,587 tokens for the keyword ripgrep+read baseline vs 347.8 for semble over 1,251 queries, capped at 32k tokens when nothing is found (benchmarks/README.md:48). The baseline is a simulated keyword-grep plus read-whole-file pipeline (benchmarks/README.md:67), not measured agent sessions. A weaker `grep+read` variant in the same file reaches only 0.125 recall at 32k (token-efficiency-0e2d85215c7e.json:24-32). `semble savings` uses an estimate of (file chars - snippet chars)/4 (stats.py:73-83, 175).

~1,250 queries (711 semantic, 343 architecture, 204 symbol), 63 repos, 19 languages; queries and relevance labels generated by Claude Sonnet 4.6 and verified by the same model as LLM-judge. No third-party measurements found in the repo.

risks: No embedding-service integration: embeddings come from an in-process static Model2Vec model (default minishlab/potion-code-16M-v2; src/semble/utils.py:11; index/dense.py:24-50), and SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME accepts only a Model2Vec-compatible local path or HF repo (README.md:285). A regex search of src/ found no HTTP embedding client, API-key variable or base-URL setting, so an externally hosted or OpenAI-compatible embedding endpoint cannot be configured. The license of the default model weights is not stated in this repo.

First-run network dependencies despite the 'no external services' headline: Hugging Face model download (README.md:189), uv fetching the pinned `semble[mcp]==X.Y.Z` from PyPI whenever a client launches the MCP command unless uv has it cached (installer/agents.py:62-69; docs/installation.md:44, 52), and `git clone` for URL repos with a 60 s default timeout (index/index.py:31, 249-259). SEMBLE_CLONE_TIMEOUT is not documented in README or docs. Offline use is documented only as the SEMBLE_MODEL_NAME local-path note (README.md:285).

Index persistence is neither atomic nor locked. SembleIndex.save writes bm25, vectors, chunks and finally metadata straight into the final cache dir (index/index.py:386-407), and only savings.jsonl uses a non-blocking flock (stats.py:88-91; no other locking or rename logic in src/). The cache is shared by CLI and MCP and keyed by resolved path + content set, not by client (cache.py:27-41), so two clients (for example Claude Code and Codex MCP servers) can race on the same repo. `from_path` does not catch errors from load_from_disk (index.py:159-161) or from reading metadata.json (cache.py:120). Inconsistent component counts or unreadable files therefore raise (index.py:352-362) until `semble clear index` is run (cli.py:207-218); in MCP this surfaces as a 'Failed to index' error string (mcp.py:44-46). Missing files and version/model/chunk-size mismatches do trigger a silent rebuild (cache.py:98-125). Tests cover rejection of bad state (tests/index/test_index.py:297-316) but not concurrent writers. This reading is from code and was not executed.

Freshness is mtime-based only: an index is stale when a file's `st_mtime` is later than the index write time or the file set differs (cache.py:139-154; index/files.py:486-491), and per-file reuse compares mtime_ns equality (index/create.py:128). There is no content hashing, so a file restored with an older mtime can be served stale. Git-URL indexes are never revalidated (cache.py:136-137; tests/test_cache.py:268-275), so remote-repo results stay frozen until `semble clear index`. Moving or renaming a local repo changes the sha256 key (cache.py:27-34) and leaves an orphan until `semble clear orphans` (cli.py:231-252). MCP also applies a revalidation cooldown of 3x the last build time (mcp.py:34, 288).

Scope is caller-supplied, not server-enforced. The MCP `repo` argument accepts any local directory path or any http(s) URL the agent passes, with no allowlist or root setting (mcp.py:41-47, 88, 230); the CLI also accepts ssh://, git://, file:// and scp-style URLs (utils.py:9-16). Cached chunks store verbatim source text in plaintext JSON under the user cache dir (index/index.py:395; cache.py:56-89). The installer edits user-level agent configs in place (~/.claude.json, ~/.codex/config.toml) with no backup (installer/agents.py:191, 245; installer/config.py:172, 276) and pins uvx to the installed version, so upgrades require re-running `semble install` (docs/installation.md:44).

Platform coverage depends on the separate `semble-grammars` wheel set: macOS x86_64/arm64, manylinux2014 x86_64/aarch64 and Windows amd64/arm64 only (uv.lock:3905-3910). On other platforms chunking falls back to line-based with only a logged warning (chunking/core.py:24-35), which degrades retrieval quality. WSL2 is not mentioned in the docs or CI. The package imports huggingface_hub, tree_sitter and pydantic directly without declaring them (index/dense.py:9; chunking/core.py:8; installer/config.py:9; mcp.py:14; pyproject.toml:28-37). Retrieval is a brute-force in-memory cosine scan plus an in-memory BM25 persisted as JSON (index/dense.py:53-98; index/bm25.py:102-120); the benchmarks use 63 repos (one per language for speed), with no large-monorepo scaling data in the repo.

All published measurements are project-run with LLM-generated ground truth and no third-party replication in the repo (benchmarks/README.md:136). The headline quality baseline is a semantic-only CodeRankEmbed run compared with semble's hybrid pipeline (benchmarks/README.md:150). The result files do not record hardware, and README table values do not exactly match any committed result file (see claim_checks). The 99% token figure is modeled against a simulated grep+read workflow capped at 32k tokens, not measured agent sessions (benchmarks/README.md:48, 67). The test suite mocks the real embedding model everywhere (tests/conftest.py:75-90), so CI does not exercise the real default model end-to-end.

Release and governance: pre-1.0 (v0.6.1, classifier 'Development Status :: 4 - Beta'; pyproject.toml:15; src/semble/version.py:1). PyPI publishing is a manual workflow_dispatch with no test gate, no checksum/signature/SBOM step, and mutable action refs (release.yaml:3-4, 11-40). CI runs tests only; ruff, mypy and pydoclint are not in CI (ci.yaml:49-53; .pre-commit-config.yaml:23-41). There is no SECURITY.md. CONTRIBUTING requires a linked issue and says it will not accept dependency additions or large features (CONTRIBUTING.md:7-8, 30-35). The LICENSE copyright holder is an individual (LICENSE:3). v0.6.1's release date cannot be determined from the shallow clone.
